title: Thresholds, ROC and Precision–Recall Curves
learning_objectives: Summarise a classifier's scores with ROC AUC and average precision
Read precision and recall at every threshold with precision_recall_curve
Choose a decision threshold that meets a recall target
hints: `precision, recall, thresholds = precision_recall_curve(y_true, scores)`; only the first `len(thresholds)` points have thresholds.
Among indices i with `recall[i] >= min_recall`, take the one with the largest `thresholds[i]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Pick the highest threshold whose recall still reaches min_recall.
roc_auc_score takes scores, not thresholded labels.
precision[i], recall[i] belong to thresholds[i]; ignore the final extra point.
Require both classes, equal lengths and 0 < min_recall <= 1.
